records.run: high-z zooms, redshift-evolving fit (Slope and normalization evolution, A(z) and B(z))

representation.equation: log(Z/Zsun) = A(z) log(M*/Msun) + B(z); A = a ((1+z)/9)^alpha, B = b ((1+z)/9)^beta

selection.population: galaxies of the FIRE-2 high-redshift zoom suite at integer redshifts z=5-12, linear fits to medians in five stellar-mass bins
selection.warning: Slope and normalization evolution, A(z) and B(z). Fit of Marszewski et al. 2024 to bin medians of the zoom sample (not volume complete) over log M* = 6 to the sample maximum; the domain 6-10.5 is the plotted fit range read from the paper's figure. Metallicity is the mass-weighted mean over gas within 0.2 Rvir; O/H follows from 12+log(O/H) = log(Z/Zsun) + 9.00 (the paper's FIRE-1 calibration, with its systematics).
